_note: No machine credentials in the repository. Set AI_SYSTEM6_DEVELOPER_ID (the 40-hex SHA-1 of the Developer ID Application certificate) and AI_SYSTEM6_NOTARY_PROFILE (a notarytool keychain profile name) in the environment, or fill developerId/notaryProfile in gitignored signing.local.json. The private key and notary credential live in the login keychain.
